profiles.summary: Pinned local chart rendering with local file references disabled.
Official Microsoft Fabric documentation and best-practices server with no live tenant access.
Official Azure DevOps MCP restricted by the host to read-only tools for one organization.
profiles.authentication: Interactive sign-in at server launch. The operator supplies the organization name.

profiles.summary: Official Azure MCP, pinned in read-only Kusto namespace mode; it is not an Azure Synapse server.
profiles.authentication: Azure CLI or managed identity with appropriate Azure RBAC.

profiles.summary: Official Microsoft Fabric Real-Time Intelligence preview, restricted to known non-production Kusto services.
profiles.authentication: Azure Identity. The operator must configure an explicit non-production Kusto allow-list in the referenced environment file.

profiles.summary: Source-pinned, locally built evidence-first public YouTube research server without direct-provider credentials.
profiles.authentication: No credential for transcript tools. A YouTube API key is optional and is intentionally not configured by this profile.

profiles.summary: Scout-provided WorkIQ access to Microsoft 365 data.
profiles.authentication: Managed by Scout and Microsoft 365 sign-in.
profiles.canary: Confirm the native workiq server is exposed by Scout.
profiles.reason: Do not register duplicate external Work IQ MCP endpoints in Scout.
No verified Microsoft-supported Synapse-specific MCP package or hosted server contract is available.

profiles.summary: Official hosted Fabric IQ Ontology MCP Server.
profiles.reason: Preview service with no published fixed tool inventory, read-only control, OAuth scope contract, or versioned server release.

profiles.summary: Official hosted Fabric Data Warehouse and SQL Endpoint MCP Server.
profiles.reason: Its executeSQL tool can run arbitrary DDL and DML; the hosted Preview contract has no server-side read-only or query allow-list control.

profiles.summary: Official local Power BI Modeling MCP Server.
profiles.reason: Preview server with broad model mutation capability, write-permission prerequisites, no independently verified immutable package release, and a preview EULA.
Vendor driver licensing, credential/egress controls, and a dedicated read-only database identity require separate commercial and security approval.

profiles.summary: Quanti hosted data-warehouse MCP with claimed Azure Synapse support.
profiles.reason: Third-party hosted service has no admission-ready data handling, retention, credential, or service-versioning contract.

profiles.summary: Unverified community Azure Synapse MCP implementations.
profiles.reason: Reviewed implementations have incomplete package, licensing, provenance, or read-only controls and must not be installed from this catalog.
